messages:
kevin: Heads up — opened a docs PR for the private deploy installer that combines KMS/HSM guidance with air-gapped egress notes: https://git.company/repo/pull/5421. Want to coordinate reviewers and make sure the network matrix is explicit (NAT, SNAT, proxy chaining).

maria: Thanks! I skimmed the PR. Can we split the KMS HSM section into: overview + cert handling + example PKCS#11 config? It's getting dense.

ashley: @maria +1. Also we should add a short 'troubleshooting' subsection about common TLS errors when the HSM has incorrect time. Seen that twice in the field.

ben: Quick note on egress: for fully air-gapped installs we recommend a one-time outbound fetch URL with signed bundle. For VPC installs with limited egress, doc should show explicit iptables rule to allow the fetch host and DNS: 

```
# allow fetch host and DNS
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 199.51.100.23/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
# then SNAT to NAT gateway
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source 10.0.0.5
```

maria: Nice, can we also include a minimal systemd snippet for the KMS proxy service (so folks copy/paste)?

kevin: Added a systemd example to the PR, plus a short inline snippet for PKCS11 env vars. Example I put in the PR: 

```
[Unit]
Description=redwood-kms-proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Environment="PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so"
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

ashley: Small editorial request: spell out HSM vendor-neutral steps and avoid vendor-specific commands. We can add a callout box that says "vendor steps may vary".

maria: Link fix: the PR references the old diagram at /assets/net-diagram-v1.png — replace with /assets/private-network-topology-v2.png. I left a note in the diff.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR 5421 needs at least two approvals before merge. Missing: security review and one engineering review.

kevin: Thanks @docs-bot. @sre-liaison can you take the security review for the KMS key rotation section? I flagged the rotation cadence recommendation (30d vs 90d) for discussion.

sre-liaison: I can review by EOD tomorrow. Regarding rotation cadence: 90d default with a note to shorten for higher-risk environments. Also recommend including an offline key-escrow pattern for air-gapped customers.

maria: I'll make the editorial fixes and split the HSM section into two subsections as discussed. Planning to push an update tonight and request reviews again.

kevin: Perfect. After updates, can someone run the installer quickstart in a small VPC and paste the `journalctl -u redwood-installer` tail if anything looks suspicious? Even a short capture helps.

ashley: I can spin up a test VPC tomorrow and capture logs. Will paste back snippets in this thread. :thumbsup:

ben: One more small ask — add a short table mapping required outbound ports by feature (installer fetch, KMS proxy handshake, HSM time sync). People search for that first.

kevin: Good call. I'll add the table in the PR update. Thanks everyone — follow-ups in the PR and will ping once changes are pushed.
